confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by beachfront location and season. Baht-to-USD conversion is assumed at roughly 32-35 THB per USD. Accommodation anchors assume Thai VAT and the typical 10% service charge are included. The FX observation comes from search-result text citing the RBA exchange-rates overview; I did not open the RBA page, so verify the 0.6955 value against the RBA F11 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Thai resort-island pricing (Phuket and Krabi tourist areas) adjusted down slightly for Koh Samui's smaller market and lower hotel rates, with July treated as a moderate-demand shoulder period on the Gulf side. Drink prices are estimated from the local beer price relationship: cocktails and wine are set at roughly 2.5 to 3 times the draft beer price.
